purpose: Pins ms1-dup's numbers of record (FACTS_v10.json) by commit and checksum, WITHOUT carrying a single value. scripts/check_facts.py reads the exact bytes from git at this commit and refuses on any sha256 mismatch.
why_not_vendored: This repo's root is published by GitHub Pages, so anything tracked here is public. FACTS_v10.json carries tau percentages, which Chen has held off the site until he reopens them, and v10 figures while the atlas data is held on v9. A vendored copy would publish both on the next push -- caught before it did, 2026-09-20. Pinning the commit keeps every value out of the public tree and is stronger anyway: it reads the pinned bytes whatever the ms1-dup checkout has checked out, so a stale clone cannot feed the check the wrong file.
